claim_boundary: Train-only metadata-and-sequence reconstruction of complete antibody systems. The output is not a contact-label cache, training set, validation split, test set, or performance result, and it does not authorize model training or selection.

reconstruction.antibody_antigen_support: Every antibody-antigen support edge must be listed by both corresponding SAbDab roles, belong to PINDER train, and occur in the frozen role-exclusive antibody-antigen inventory.
reconstruction.antigen_scope: One physical PINDER protein-chain monomer per reconstructed system; multi-chain antigens are represented as separately auditable systems at this gate.
reconstruction.fab: Require non-overlapping heavy and light monomers plus a PINDER-train H-L edge listed by both SAbDab roles. Attach an antigen monomer when at least one strict train H-antigen or L-antigen support edge exists; the unsupported antibody chain remains an explicit all-negative candidate axis for later label materialization.
reconstruction.heavy_only_or_vhh: Require a mapped heavy monomer, no declared light chain, and a strict train heavy-antigen support edge. This gate does not infer VHH biology beyond the heavy-only SAbDab topology.
reconstruction.physical_copy_rule: PINDER monomer identifiers, not sequence identity or PDB-level Cartesian products, define physical copies.
reconstruction.role_ambiguity: Exclude any SAbDab row whose mapped antibody and antigen monomer sets overlap.
reconstruction.scfv: For SAbDab scfv=true, treat each mapped H/L-union monomer as one fused antibody chain and require a strict train fused-chain-antigen support edge; no H-L edge is required.
reconstruction.unsupported_topologies: Exclude light-only and no-antibody rows. Do not silently reinterpret incomplete Fab rows as heavy-only systems.
